post_topic: Why governance and HITL must be in the blueprint on day one — not retrofitted after the demo impresses someone
scene_description: A split-screen diagram contrasting a polished vendor demo UI showing a flawless AI agent responding in clean JSON against a messy architectural reality: overlapping tenant namespaces without isolation boundaries, a HITL checkpoint bolted on as an afterthought flag, and a service principal with an oversized blast radius drawn around it. In the center, a red question mark hovers over the gap between the demo and the Cloud Decoded production architecture — namespace-scoped context injection, per-tenant audit trails, and state-machine-enforced human confirmation checkpoints — none of which appear in the vendor slide. The tension is between what the demo shows and what enterprise multi-tenant production actually requires.
